content.short: Bemo is a decentralized liquid staking protocol on TON that allows users to stake and receive stTON.
content.description: Bemo is a leading decentralized liquid staking protocol built specifically for The Open Network (TON). It enables users to stake their Toncoin and receive stTON (staked TON) tokens in return, which represent their share of the staking pool and its accrued rewards. Unlike traditional staking, Bemo allows users to maintain liquidity, as stTON can be used across various TON DeFi applications for lending, borrowing, and yield farming. Bemo focuses on providing a secure, non-custodial, and efficient way for users to support network validation while maximizing their capital utility.
content.meta: Stake TON and stay liquid with Bemo. The premier liquid staking protocol on TON, featured on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
